title: Satwik-Chirag Win China Masters, Eye Asian Games Encore
indian_angle: India's top men's doubles pair, Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, secured a significant title, boosting national hopes for the upcoming Asian Games.
summary: Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty bounced back from a tough World Championship to triumph at the China Masters, reigniting hopes for the Asian Games.

title: PV Sindhu Aims for Asian Games Medal with Renewed Confidence
indian_angle: Two-time Olympic medallist PV Sindhu, a beacon of Indian badminton, is gearing up for her fourth Asian Games appearance with a focus on securing a medal.
summary: PV Sindhu enters her 4th Asian Games with renewed confidence and fitness, aiming for a medal amidst tough competition in Aichi-Nagoya.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Underway in Guwahati, Raipur
indian_angle: This national coaching program in India is crucial for developing the next generation of badminton talent and improving coaching standards across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) is conducting its Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at National Centers of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd, 2026.

title: BAI Releases Regulations for 2026 Inter State Team Championships
indian_angle: The release of these regulations sets the stage for a key domestic tournament that helps identify and nurture talent from various Indian states.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has issued the official regulations for the upcoming Inter State Team Championships 2026, outlining rules and guidelines for participating teams.

title: Indian Junior Team Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Championships
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is vital for preparing India's promising young players for international junior competitions.
summary: A coaching camp for the Indian junior team is being held at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing players for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: This significant change in scoring format for U-13, U-15, and U-17 national championships will impact player development and match strategies in India.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has announced the implementation of the 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
